name: aus-food-store
description: Aus Food Store — customer storefront + admin portal prototype (Phase 1)

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @aus/mock-api & npm run dev -w @aus/storefront & npm run dev -w @aus/admin & wait

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/storefront --noEmit && tsc -p apps/admin --noEmit && tsc -p apps/mock-api --noEmit
